note: Things in the twin/profile that are NOT yet confirmed (PV names, motor roles, links). Each item says what value is in use, why it is doubtful and how to confirm it. Edit status/note in the GUI (Beamline Twin > To verify; right-click > Edit) once confirmed; 'ref' says where the value lives. Never confirmed by guessing: status 'verified' needs evidence in 'note'.

items.subject: retiga2 (hutch B tomo camera) PV prefix
items.why: Taken from the CS-Studio IOC Control list (row 'Tomo_in_B', Windows QImage IOC on aszu). Nothing on the displays says that 'retiga2' is that camera, and the displays have no PV panel for it, so the image PV (<prefix>Pva1:Image per camera_pva_suffix) may not exist under this name.
items.how: At the beamline: confirm with staff which camera is in B; check that QIMAGE2:Pva1:Image (or the IOC's real image PV) exists and shows the B tomo view; then set the real suffix/prefix. Also the B-TOMO element (tomoB) is not linked to this camera yet.

items.subject: E fast shutter: which motor is x and which is y
items.why: Log-panel motor descriptions (FS2X E = m77, FS2Y E = m75) and mpe_bluesky agree; the CS-Studio layout button labels them FS_X = m75, FS_Y = m77.
items.how: Staff / jog test at the shutter (not from BLADE): which motor moves it horizontally.

items.subject: LabMotion SMS (C): x and z motors
items.why: Log-panel descriptions (samXC = m25, samZC = m27) and mpe_bluesky say x = m25, z = m27; the CS-Studio LabMotion_SMS button labels m25 samZ and m27 samX. y = m26 is the same on display and logs (mpe_bluesky had 1idGalil1:m1). The NeXus metadata map (Aug 2026) also has HR samX = m25, samZ = m27 (agrees with logs and code).
items.how: Jog m25 and check the direction relative to the beam (+Z is the beam direction on the panel).

items.subject: 1idc:m31 role (LabMotion translation or rotX?)
items.why: Display: LabMotion_TransX / Trans_X. Log panels: 'rotXC'. mpe_bluesky has rotx = 1idGalil1:m2 (not on display or logs). The NeXus metadata map has HR RotX = 1idc:m31, which agrees with the log-panel description rotXC.
items.how: Read the motor record description (DESC) of 1idc:m31 on the beamline.

items.subject: Hydra D4 z motor
items.why: Display button opens P=1idc: M=m7 (Hydra_D4); mpe_bluesky has 1ide1:m7; the logs never show it. A C-hutch IOC prefix driving an E detector is plausible but unusual.
items.how: Check which of 1idc:m7 / 1ide1:m7 exists and moves Hydra D4.

items.subject: B Kohzu slit blade motors
items.value: Xp m60, Xn m59, Yp m61, Yn m58 (4slitGraphic)
items.why: The B layout's test_slits panel lists m32 instead of m59; 1idb:m32 is Table1 M0X on the top panel, so m59 is more likely.
items.how: Read the slit record 1idb:SlitHxn / the motor descriptions.

items.subject: SAXS D6 shield motor
items.why: Only from mpe_bluesky; the SAXS_D6 panel on the display has m51, m52, m53, m54, m66 but not m49.
items.how: Read the DESC of 1ide1:m49.

items.subject: E-station shutter PV (S01ID-PSS:SES:)
items.why: A/B/C = FES/SBS/SCS are paired with the labelled control buttons; SES is the fourth status PV, assigned to E by elimination (the display has no E control).
items.how: Compare the E-Station status box with the SES PV.

items.subject: NF D2 TiltY motor prefix
items.why: The logs give the name 'NF TiltY' only by motor number 6; the NF_D2 panel has both 1ide1:m6 and 1ide:m6.
items.how: Read the DESC of both.

items.subject: gh1 pixel size
items.note: user 2026-11-15: GH1 is the 5x lens at 0.69 um/px (red box on the 'Camera Options' slide, middle column; 3.45 um pitch / 5 = 0.69); the logs give 0.69 um/px at 5X from 2025 to Oct 2026. No calibration-target image exists.
items.why: The user wrote '69 micron' once; 0.69 was adopted and fits the real frames, never confirmed against a calibration target.
items.how: Image a ruled target / known slit through gh1.

items.subject: gh1 camera model: GS3-U3-89S6M (user) or GS3-U3-123S6M (CS-Studio panel title)
items.why: The user fixed GH1 as the middle-column camera of the Camera Options slide (89S6M, V FOV 1.49 mm). The CS-Studio Tomo D1 button opens the 1idGH1 ADSpinnaker panel titled PGR_GS3-U3-123S6M (IMX253, 4096 x 3000, V FOV 2.07 mm). Pixel size, pitch and H FOV (2.826 mm) are identical for both; only the model and the vertical size differ. All logged ROI crops fit inside 2160 rows (largest: y 475 + 1490 = 1965), which does not separate them.
items.how: Read the camera model and sensor size from the 1idGH1 IOC (ADSpinnaker model / MaxSizeY readback, read-only) or the label on the camera; then drop the wrong side from spec.conflict.

items.subject: B hutch lens stacks: mapping stack -> BL4/BL5
items.why: Both display buttons are labelled Stack1 (motors m43/m45 and m25/m64); which lens each belongs to is a guess.
items.how: Staff / drawings.

items.subject: hutch C Tomo camera IOC: 1idSP5 or 1idPG5
items.why: The Tomo D1 (C) button opens an ADSpinnaker panel for 1idSP5 and a pointGrey panel for 1idPG5; the IOC list has only 1idSP5.
items.how: Check which IOC is running on the beamline.

items.subject: HEM motor roles 1idHEM:m1, m4, m5, m6, m7, m8
items.value: favoured (not confirmed): m1 = Th1, m4 = Th2, m8 = Z2, m7 = Roll 2 Coarse (CSV: Chi2); m5/m6 = X2/Y2 (display only)
items.why: Three kinds of record. (1) CS-Studio HEM_control_1id.bob widget names: m1 = Z2Aero, m4 = Chi2, m8 = Th1, m7 = Th2, m5 = X2, m6 = Y2. (2) NeXus metadata map (mpe_xml, Aug 2026): m1 = Th1, m4 = Th2, m8 = Z2, m7 = Chi2. (3) Log panels 2026-09-23..11-03 (tier A/B): m1 'Th1 rotY1 (C1', m4 'Th2 rotY2 (C2', m8 'Z2', m7 'Roll 2 Coarse'; m8 reads 412-748 mm (Z2 range; the old Z2 Aero read 386-835 mm), m1/m4 read 0.5-2.1, m7 about -0.25. The 20-ID transform record (log, 2026-09-25) has an input 'Current Th1' = 20idHEM:m1.RBV. (2) and (3) and the 20-ID record agree; the display widget names for m1 (would be mm) and m8 (would be an angle) contradict the readback magnitudes. Caveats: only 4 screenshots at 1-ID, PV attribution in composite screenshots; m7 'Roll 2 Coarse' vs 'Chi2' is a name difference; m5/m6 appear only on the display.
items.how: Read DESC, RBV, EGU of 1idHEM:m1,m4,m5,m6,m7,m8 and the OUT links (OUTA..OUTP) and calc fields of 1id:userTran3 (read-only caget; the output whose formula is the Bragg angle writes to Th1). Also check that 1idsft1:m1 (old Z2 Aero) is gone or still present. Then set the roles in the twin with the date and the probe as evidence.

items.subject: Header strip PVs of the C/E panels
items.why: PV names truncated on the screenshots.
items.how: Open the header widget properties in CS-Studio.

items.subject: 31 log-panel devices with no PV attached
items.why: A PV is attached only if printed on a window title on >= 3 images; the rest stay open by policy (no guessed links).
items.how: Match each to a display motor (cs_registry.json) when evidence appears.

items.subject: Lens L1 (C): rotation axes m102 / m104
items.why: mpe_bluesky (th = m102, chi = m104) and the log panels (lens1_rotx = m102, lens1_rotz = m104) agree. The CS-Studio C_L1 panel (vertical lens stack) labels them the other way round: m102 'Rz (Chi)', m104 'Rx (Theta)' (L2 on the same panel type is labelled the same way as the code). The NeXus metadata map (LensRX = m102, LensRZ = m104) agrees with mpe_bluesky and the logs; only the display labels differ.
items.how: Read the motor descriptions (DESC) of 1idc:m102 and 1idc:m104; jog one and see which tilt it is.

items.subject: L5(RD) (C): its own motors
items.why: The L5(RD) display button opens panel 'C_L5' with P=1idc: and motors m99..m104 - exactly the motors of L1 (C_L1). Either a copy-paste in the display or L5 reuses the L1 stage; no separate L5 motors appear anywhere. L6(RD) opens 1idfoc:m13..m18 (distinct).
items.how: Staff: which motors belong to lens L5 (greyed '(RD)')? Compare the C_L5 and C_L1 panels on the live display.

items.subject: HEM motor PVs changed over time (old PVs vs 1idHEM:*)
items.why: Log panels show Th1 on 1ida:m11 (to 2024-11) then 1ida:m30 (2025-02 to 2026-02), Th2 on 1ida:m13 then 1ida:m32, Chi2 on 1ida:m17, Z2 Aero on 1idsft1:m1 (2024-08 to 2026-02); from 2026-09-23 the panels show 1idHEM:*. The IOC Control list still has an IOC 'HEM_Z2' = 1idsft1:, and the display calls 1idHEM:m1 'Z2Aero'. Nobody says when or why the motors moved, or whether the old PVs still exist.
items.how: Ask staff when the HEM controls moved to 1idHEM; check whether 1idsft1:m1 and 1ida:m11/m13/m17/m30/m32 still exist. Until then do not use old PVs for current-era data.

items.subject: 1idHEM:m7: 'Roll 2 Coarse' or Chi2?
items.why: Logs (2026) call m7 'Roll 2 Coarse' (reads about -0.25 in user coordinates); the display and the metadata map call it Th2 / Chi2 respectively. The transform record's Chi2 output is 0.02-0.05 deg, and the old Chi2 motor (1ida:m17) read 0.014-0.114 deg. Whether 'Roll 2 Coarse' is the Chi2 axis or only its coarse stage is not stated.
items.how: Read DESC of m7 and look for a separate fine roll axis; check which motor the Chi2 output (userTran3 M) drives.

items.subject: E HL-SMS motor map from the metadata map
items.why: Metadata map: HL RotX = 1ide1:m9 (display: MTS_X2), HL samY = 1ide1:m10 (not on display), HL samY2 = 1idcAMCI:m16 (a hutch-C AMCI IOC on an E stage). 1ide:m9 is the Aero Rot (omega) and 1ide1:m9 is a different motor with the same number: a typo in one of the records is possible.
items.how: Read DESC of 1ide1:m9, 1ide:m9, 1ide1:m10, 1idcAMCI:m16.

items.subject: C four-circle (4C) axis roles
items.value: open (candidates: th m74, phi m75, tth m85, chi m88, RotX m76)
items.why: The display shows the circles without names. The NeXus metadata map names th = 1idc:m74, phi = 1idc:m75, tth = 1idc:m85, chi = 1idc:m88 (not on display), RotX = 1idc:m76, RotY1-3/RotZ1-2 = 1idcAMCI:m6,m2,m3,m4,m5. 1idc:m40 and m86 are listed as circles in the README but have no name in any record.
items.how: Read DESC of 1idc:m40,m74,m75,m76,m85,m86,m88 and 1idcAMCI:m2-m6.

items.subject: pg1 camera: Radiograph or VFF D5
items.why: The CS-Studio display attaches 1idPG1: to the Radiograph. An earlier user remark said pg1 may belong to VFF D5 or the Radiograph; layout.md said so too. Not confirmed by anyone on the beamline.
items.how: Staff: which stage carries the pg1 camera; compare the live pg1 image with the Radiograph monitor.

items.subject: Pixel sizes of retiga2 (1.0 um/px), PG5 (1.17 um/px)
items.why: retiga2 1.0 um/px is in the profile but the logged NF Retiga is 1.48 um/px (different camera or objective?); PG5 1.17 um/px assumes a 5.86 um sensor pitch with 5x magnification (not read from a data sheet). 2026-11-15: PG5 part partly supported - the 'Camera Options' slide gives GS3-U3-23S6M (ICX825, 5.86 um) at 5x = 1.172 um/px for the 1-ID camera and the PG5 panel title is 23S6M; the slide does not say PG5 vs PG1, and retiga2 is not on it. Still no calibration target.
items.how: Image a ruled target or a slit of known width with each camera.

items.subject: Motors named only in the NeXus metadata map
items.why: These motors have a role in the metadata map but no widget on the displays or panel in the logs, so the twin has no element for them.
items.how: Read DESC; add elements only if they are beam-relevant.

items.subject: Tomo alignment-pin mount: dimensions of the chuck, rod, nut, blocks, pin protrusion/shaft
items.value: photo estimates: block 23 mm wide (assumed scale), chuck 6.6 x 21 mm, rod 2 x 20 mm exposed, pin protrusion 5 mm, shaft 0.5 mm, tip 58.6 mm above the plate
items.why: Read off one photograph; no scale in the image, so every length is +-20 % and the absolute tip height is not meaningful. The model only needs proportions for the search (chuck top edge ~protrusion below the tip), but the absolute numbers should not be quoted.
items.how: Measure with calipers: block width/height (x2), chuck body diameter and length, nose length, rod diameter and exposed length, nut across-flats, pin protrusion above the chuck nose, pin shaft diameter; also note the chuck and rod materials and whether the pin top is bevelled. Replace the values and drop the _note in sim.json stage_E.pin.mount.

items.subject: GH1 camera stage position (tomoE.x/y, 1ide1:m63 / m40) is not recorded in the alignment HDF5 files
items.value: camera position fitted so the footprint sits at (972.6, 752.3) px
items.why: The files' DMS group lists 1idc:m77/m79/m84, which are the hutch-C camera stage in the twin. So the replay cannot set the camera position from the file; it is a free fit.
items.how: Check which PVs the DMS group of the E-station profile should record; read the GH1 stage positions at the time of a scan (read-only).

items.subject: WB slit image scale (wb_edge_scale h 0.911 / v 0.709) and image profile width (h 0.80 / v 1.0)
items.value: image-only factors fitted on 85 real GH1 frames at 71.7 keV
items.why: The real footprint is smaller than the point-source projection of the 0.30 mm WB gap (0.796 mm) and softer than any E slit edge. One demagnification should narrow edges and profile alike; here h and v disagree, and the V source size needed 50 um (logs 17-23). The flux fit (0.147 mm) is unchanged.
items.how: Frames at other energies and WB gaps (footprint / gap vs energy); a frame with the E slits closed below the WB footprint (E-slit-limited sharp edges) to confirm which aperture defines what; model the HEM focusing.

items.subject: E lens stacks 1-4 positions recorded in the files are treated as not acting
items.why: The files record LensX/Y/Z/RX/RY/RZ for the E stacks, but the simulator's lens controls (x in/out, y, th, phi) mean something different; the frames show a plain slit-defined box (no collapse into a line).
items.how: Confirm with staff which E stacks were in the beam for the 2026-10-26 alignment scans and map the motors to the simulator's lens model.
